blocks.label: Figure
blocks.text: Building rules: what each plot size allows. Numbers refer to the rules below.
blocks.alt: Building rules: what each plot size allows. Numbers refer to the rules below. Labels on the drawing: 30.48 m, Under 600 sqft, 600 to 1,000 sqft, 1,000 to 2,500 sqft, 2,500 sqft and above, 3 storeys, 9 m, 8 storeys, 24.6 m, 10 storeys, 30.48 m, 10 storeys, 30.48 m, No setback, 1 m setback, 1.2 m setback, 1.5 m setback.

cards.title: Ten storeys at most
cards.text: No building rises above 10 storeys, 30.48 m overall.

cards.title: Plot size sets height
cards.text: The smallest plots stay at walk-up scale. Height is earned with plot area.

cards.title: Setbacks on two sides
cards.text: Buildings step back from one side and the back of the plot, more as the plot grows.

cards.title: Density is capped
cards.text: Plots over 600 sqft keep a floor area ratio between 4.5 and 5.5.

cards.title: Roofs that work
cards.text: At least 40% of the roof carries solar panels, and every roof collects rainwater.

cards.title: Twice the site in green
cards.text: Green plot ratio of 2.0: roof gardens, planted facades and ground planting.

cards.title: Shaded east and west
cards.text: Louvres, deep balconies or 1.2 m overhangs on facades above 12 m.

cards.title: Open to the breeze
cards.text: Deep floor plates need single-loaded corridors or an open lightwell.

blocks.heading: Building regulations: the district
blocks.label: Figure
blocks.text: District rules: movement, the coast and services. Numbers refer to the rules below.
blocks.alt: District rules: movement, the coast and services. Numbers refer to the rules below. Labels on the drawing: 60 m, 200 m.

cards.title: A 10 m coastal buffer
cards.text: No permanent foundations within 10 m of the high-water line. Planting and raised timber decks only.

cards.title: The beach stays public
cards.text: A public corridor runs from the streets to the beach every 60 m.

cards.title: Cars keep to the edge
cards.text: Four-wheeled vehicles use only the ring road and the primary corridors.

cards.title: No private traffic
cards.text: Private cars, taxis and ride-hailing do not enter the district.

cards.title: Streets for people
cards.text: Inner streets carry pedestrians, bicycles and two-wheelers at 15 km/h.

cards.title: Parking at the edge
cards.text: All parking sits in hubs within 200 m, a 3-minute walk, of any door.

cards.title: One logistics hub
cards.text: Deliveries unload at the edge and go the last stretch by electric cart, off-peak.

cards.title: Open to emergencies
cards.text: Fire, ambulance and police reach every street and path, at all hours.
